title: acer negundo var. californicum
intro: Acer negundo var. californicum, commonly known as California Box Elder, is a deciduous tree or shrub native to the western United States and Mexico. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, fever, and pain, due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and analgesic effects. The bioactive constituents of California Box Elder include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the potential therapeutic actions and benefits of this plant, and it should be used under the guidance of a qualified healthcare professional.
